test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 9th December 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which island country in the Arabian sea is a neighbour of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maldives.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Maldives island country in the Arabian sea is a neighbour of India.**
 
• The Maldives is a nation of islands in the Indian Ocean, that spans the equator.
 
• The country is comprised of 1192 islands.
 
• The Maldives lies** southwest of Sri Lanka and India,** about 750 kilometres from the Asian continent's mainland. 
 
• **Maldives:**
 
 
• **​**Capital: Malé
 
• President: Mohamed Muizzu 
 
• Continent: Asia
 
• Population: 5.41 lakhs (2020)
 
• Currencies: United States Dollar, Maldivian rufiyaa
 
• Official language: Dhivehi
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **Confusion Points__**

 
• **Srilanka **lies in the Indian Ocean.
 
• **Indonesia** is a country in Southeast Asia and Oceania between the Indian and Pacific oceans.
 
• Myanmar is located in South-east Asia.
